subject: note:propria_surface_design_contract_20260912
title: Propria surface contract and broken Probata adoption boundary
summary: Owner direction recorded 2026-09-12. The current Probata product is utterly broken and must not be treated as the approved experience, a usable baseline, or proof of design adoption. The shared design contract is a target and coordination boundary only. Canonical contract: E:/AI_Workspace/Projects/Propria/SURFACE-DESIGN-CONTRACT.md. Canonical reusable package: E:/AI_Workspace/Projects/Propria/design-contract (was resources/design until 2026-09-18); E:/AI_Workspace/Projects/Propria/design-contract is a compatibility junction. tokens.json is the single editable color/token source, build.mjs generates tokens.css, and verify.mjs verifies generator drift, semantic color and density parity, adapters, sample integration, CSS policy, and contrast. The Carbon-Linen-Seal palette is accepted for now specifically so it can be adjusted centrally across the platform. Exact owner-facing surfaces are: Indicia Probata General = Evidence Operations Desk; Indicia Probata Advanced = Modular Service Cockpit, using the approved Probata mock as structural authority but remaining gated with no implemented /advanced or /cockpit route; advocatio Legal Workdesk; and the separate Family Court Console. Probata and advocatio must align in shell geometry, semantic colors, context strip, cards, results, and provenance, while advocatio preserves legal states, privacy, two-clock chronology, LegalSourcePackage consumption, and its authority boundary. Independent adoption lanes are required for Probata, Consignatio Intake, advocatio, and Family Court Console; assignees are UNASSIGNED until an actual task owns them. First complete and verify the Propria migration transaction, then product lanes may proceed in parallel from a pinned vendored contract copy, followed by one cross-surface reconciliation lane owned by the Consolidate design contracts task or an explicit successor. Every product adoption must prove pinned-source provenance, token generation and drift checks, lint/build/tests, rendered browser parity, keyboard/focus/accessibility checks, deployment identity, auth behavior, and live workflow execution. Package verification is not product adoption; static validation is not deployment or runtime proof. Current callability evidence is limited: Probata primary routes are /, /intake, and /evidence/preview; /matter remains gated; no implemented Probata legal or advanced launch exchange is proven. Family Court tool names are candidates only and current-session availability is not proven. Same-day Probata probes disagreed between HTTP 403 and 200, which is an unresolved territory mismatch. Docstore note persistence is separate from CocoIndex source freshness and does not repair Probata.
rationale: The owner accepted the centralized, easily adjustable template direction, confirmed the Probata approved mock as the advanced structural reference, required Probata and advocatio to align without merging their authority boundaries, requested that all decisions be added to Docstore notes, and then explicitly corrected the implementation status: Probata is utterly broken. This revision supersedes the earlier proposal framing while preserving the distinction between an approved design direction and an unverified or broken running product.
